name: ksys-client-appManager
description: Kurtosys Studio App Manager shell — required default (loads child widgets + shared CSS)

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/flatten-build.cjs && node scripts/prepare-shared-css.cjs && node scripts/inline-css.cjs && node scripts/clean-dist.cjs
scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=dev HOST_MODE=dxm npm run build
scripts.build:dxm:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=dev HOST_MODE=dxm npm run build
scripts.build:cms:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=dev HOST_MODE=cms npm run build
scripts.build:stg: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=stg HOST_MODE=dxm npm run build
scripts.build:prd: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=prd HOST_MODE=dxm npm run build
scripts.build:dxm:stg: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=stg HOST_MODE=dxm npm run build
scripts.build:dxm:prd: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=prd HOST_MODE=dxm npm run build
scripts.build:cms:stg: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=stg HOST_MODE=cms npm run build
scripts.build:cms:prd: cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=prd HOST_MODE=cms npm run build
